/api/me/onboarding.name: Workplace harassment and violence policy
/api/me/onboarding.nameFr: Politique sur le harcèlement et la violence au travail
/api/me/onboarding.policyText: Our organization does not tolerate harassment or violence. Report concerns to your supervisor, HR or the health and safety committee. Reports are investigated promptly and kept confidential as far as possible. Nobody will face reprisal for reporting in good faith.

/api/me/onboarding.name: Privacy and confidentiality
/api/me/onboarding.policyText: You may see personal information about the public and coworkers. Use it only for your job, never share it outside work, and report any loss or misuse to your supervisor right away.

/api/me/onboarding.name: Code of conduct
/api/me/onboarding.policyText: Treat the public and coworkers with respect, follow safety procedures, be on time, and raise concerns early.

toSign.title: Respectful workplace policy
toSign.body: Everyone has the right to a workplace free of harassment and violence. Report concerns to your supervisor or HR; reports are handled confidentially and promptly.
